content.name: soulbot_aibp_bot_directory v2.1.0

output_mode.L0: Output JSON in ENGLISH: {action, results_count, source, entries}
output_mode.L1: Output helpfully in User's exact language and script variant

content.description: AIBP Directory Service client — registers agent in public/federated directories, searches agents by capability/interest/domain, browses directory listings, and parses directory responses. Implements AIBP §7 with aibot-directory@aibp.dev as well-known address. v1.6.0: Hardening — ASSERT gates on all functions, json_schema output declaration, agentic_prompt annotations, documentation enhancement. Local cache for offline discovery.

action.agentic_prompt: Set by main orchestrator DiscoverPipeline or RegisterPipeline.

directory_address.description: Directory service AIBP address. Default: aibot-directory@aibp.dev.

search_query.agentic_prompt: Extracted from user message by DiscoverPipeline.

identity_card.description: Identity Card content for registration. Required for register.

raw_response.description: Raw directory response email content. Required for parse_response.

workspace_dir.description: Directory for cache storage at workspace_dir/directory/

aisop.main:
graph TD
    Start([Start]) --> DetermineAction[DetermineAction]
    DetermineAction -->|register| PrepareRegister[PrepareRegister]
    DetermineAction -->|search| CheckCache[CheckCache]
    DetermineAction -->|browse| CheckCache
    DetermineAction -->|parse_response| ParseDirectoryResponse[ParseDirectoryResponse]
    CheckCache -->|cache_hit| FormatResults[FormatResults]
    CheckCache -->|cache_miss| PrepareSearch[PrepareSearch]
    PrepareRegister --> End((End))
    PrepareSearch --> End
    ParseDirectoryResponse --> UpdateCache[UpdateCache]
    UpdateCache --> FormatResults[FormatResults]
    FormatResults --> End((End))

steps: step1: [ASSERT] Valid parameters received. Required: action, aibp_address, workspace_dir. | Validate action parameter: register, search, browse, parse_response.
step2: For register: verify identity_card provided. For search: verify search_query has at least one field. For parse_response: verify raw_response provided.
step3: Set directory_address to default 'aibot-directory@aibp.dev' if not provided.
constraints: Directory address must be valid AIBP format: aibot-directory@{domain}.
SECURITY: Validate directory_address format. Reject addresses not starting with 'aibot-directory@'.

PrepareRegister.description: Compose INTRODUCE message to directory service for registration per §7.1
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: identity_card, directory_address. | Build registration message: type=INTRODUCE, recipient=directory_address, content=identity_card summary.
step2: Add L0 metadata: {type: 'INTRODUCE', purpose: 'directory_registration', capabilities, interests, domain}.
step3: Add X-AIBP-Directory-Action: register header.
step4: Return composed email for main module to send.
constraints: Registration is idempotent. Identity Card must include all 8 required fields.
SECURITY: Do not include private fields in directory registration unless opted in.

CheckCache.description: Check local directory cache before sending network request
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: action in [search,browse], workspace_dir. | Load cache from workspace_dir/directory/cache_index.json.
step2: Filter cache entries matching search_query. Match: capability=substring, interest=substring, domain=exact, keyword=any field.
step3: If matches found and cache < 24h → route to FormatResults.
step4: If no matches or expired → route to PrepareSearch.
constraints: Cache TTL: 24h default, 48h for federated. Empty cache on first run expected.

PrepareSearch.description: Compose DISCOVER message to directory service per §7.2
steps: step1: [ASSERT] CheckCache executed with cache_miss. Required: search_query or browse action. | Build search message: type=DISCOVER, recipient=directory_address.
step2: Set L1 content to natural language query. Set L0 metadata with search parameters. Support entity_type 'agent'|'group'.
step3: Return composed email for main module to send asynchronously.
constraints: DISCOVER uses T0 trust. Rate limit: max 10/hour per directory.

ParseDirectoryResponse.description: Parse incoming directory response and extract agent listings
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: raw_response. | Validate response from directory address (aibot-directory@*).
step2: Extract L1 and L0 content. Validate agent_address format per entry.
step3: Route to UpdateCache with parsed results.
constraints: SECURITY: Only parse responses from verified directory addresses.
Discard duplicates. L0 failure falls back to L1 extraction.

UpdateCache.description: Update local directory cache with fresh results
steps: step1: [ASSERT] ParseDirectoryResponse executed. Required: parsed_results, workspace_dir. | Load/create cache. Merge new results. Remove entries older than 7 days.
step2: Save updated cache. Route to FormatResults.
constraints: Max cache size: 1000 entries. SECURITY: No path traversal.

FormatResults.description: Format directory results for user display
steps: step1: [ASSERT] CheckCache or UpdateCache executed. Required: result_entries. | Sort: exact matches first, then partial, then alphabetical. Max 20 per page.
step2: Format each entry with agent name, address, capabilities. Add cache indicator if applicable.
constraints: Human-readable display (§1.5). Include full AIBP address (Axiom 0 traceability).

Error.DetermineAction: retry(2) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(inform User with valid options) -> inform(User). IMPORTANT.
Error.PrepareRegister: retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(inform User) -> inform(User). Identity card incomplete → list missing fields.
Error.CheckCache: retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(treat as cache miss) -> inform(User). Cache corrupted → treat as miss.
Error.PrepareSearch: retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(inform User) -> inform(User). Empty query → request at least one criterion.
Error.ParseDirectoryResponse: retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(inform User) -> inform(User). Not from directory → reject with warning.
Error.UpdateCache: retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return results without caching) -> inform(User). Write failure → return results without caching.
Error.FormatResults: retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(return raw entries) -> inform(User). Empty results → suggest broader search.

endNode.output: Return directory operation result with source indication (cache/pending/parsed).
constraints: Register output is composed email. Search may be immediate (cache) or async (email).
